author: Zuxt
body:
My IGN: Zuxt
Why I was banned: Hacking
Why I should be unbanned: Hello, I have recently rediscovered your server and would wish to play it, but it seems roughly 2 years ago I was pretty stupid and thought hacking on here would be a good idea, and was banned for it. I have not used hacks for a long time now, I still don't know why I did on here in the first place so I greatly apologise for that. I would like to be unbanned as I believe 2 years would be enough time for a punishment and would like to continue playing on your wonderful server. Thank you for considering, and I will not ruin this second chance if given one.
